A City Tour Introduction: 导游对一座古城的介绍独白。
Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Old Town.
column3: 大家早上好,欢迎来到老城。

A City Tour Introduction: Our walk today takes about ninety minutes.
column3: 我们今天的步行游览大约九十分钟。

A City Tour Introduction: Old Town was built more than six hundred years ago.
column3: 老城建城已有六百多年历史。

A City Tour Introduction: The tower on your left is the oldest building here.
column3: 您左边的塔是这里最古老的建筑。

A City Tour Introduction: It was once used to watch for fires and enemies.
column3: 它曾被用来瞭望火灾和敌人。

A City Tour Introduction: Nowadays, it offers a wonderful view of the whole city.
column3: 如今在塔上可以俯瞰全城美景。

A City Tour Introduction: In fifteen minutes, we'll reach the famous craft market.
column3: 十五分钟后我们会到达著名的手工艺市场。

A City Tour Introduction: There you can watch artists making paper and glass.
column3: 在那里您可以观看艺人造纸和制作玻璃。

A City Tour Introduction: Please keep together and watch your steps on the stone roads.
column3: 请跟紧队伍,在石板路上注意脚下。

# title: What was the tower used for in the past?
A City Tour Introduction: Storing food.|Watching for fires and enemies.|Holding meetings.|Keeping prisoners.

# title: What can visitors see at the craft market?
